name: Landhaus Haberl
beschreibung: Landhaus Haberl welcomes guests to the heart of Gerlos in the upper Zillertal Valley, situated at an altitude of approximately 1,250 meters. This welcoming alpine guesthouse combines relaxed mountain living with sincere family hospitality. Bright, comfortable guest rooms and apartments feature private balconies overlooking the rugged three-thousand-meter peaks of the Zillertal Alps. Located right in town, local restaurants, shops, and the Dorfbahn Gerlos gondola are within easy walking distance. Winter guests enjoy direct access to the expansive Zillertal Arena ski network, while summer reveals five scenic side valleys for hiking and biking.
kurzbeschreibung: Cozy guesthouse in central Gerlos in the Zillertal Valley close to the Zillertal Arena cable cars.
